coverageContext: Complete published 15-term PRS-CC, including its exactly reviewed deletion; no terms removed. Evaluated prospectively in 57,359 Chinese women (237 incident cases) over median 11.33 years. Adjusted HR per SD 1.20 [1.06,1.36]; the reported C-index 0.566 includes covariates and is not GA genetic-only performance. GA provides only the original unstandardized genetic sum, not personal absolute risk, diagnosis or prediction of HPV infection/persistence. Portability outside the evaluated population is unestablished; European reference comparisons are withheld. Not a basis for changing HPV vaccination, HPV/Pap screening, follow-up or treatment. Deletion population frequencies and whole-model reference rankings are unavailable; missing, conflicting or unsupported genotypes cannot supply a complete score.
